/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: The Deluxe Junior See Saw is a two-seat see saw with Knight Blue seats, built for one pair of children. It suits the 3 to 9 years Key User Group, so a pre-primary child and an older sibling can share it comfortably. Children take turns pushing off the ground, and they soon learn to match each other's timing, which makes it a good first lesson in cooperative play. The see saw measures 7' x 2'3" and needs a safe play area of 11' x 6'3". It is a sensible starting piece for a small society garden or a school play corner. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded seats carry a 3-year warranty, and the pivot bearing is covered for 1 year. Ask us for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.spec_paragraph: This see saw has a galvanised steel beam and roto-moulded seats, so it handles monsoon rain without rusting. We set it up self-standing or grouted to suit your site. Lay rubber flooring under both seat ends where children land, and check the pivot and handle grips at every maintenance round.
flags: Product Area and Safe Play Area are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: Four children can ride the Deluxe Multi See Saw at once, two at each end, on Knight Blue seats. That doubles the number of children a single see saw can keep busy, which matters on a school ground at break time or a society garden in the evening. It suits the 3 to 9 years Key User Group. Children at the same end learn to push together, which adds a teamwork element to a familiar ride. The see saw measures 9'8" x 2'3", with a safe play area of 13'8" x 6'3". Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts, and bearings carry a 1-year warranty. Send us your site size and we will mark it on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.spec_paragraph: A longer galvanised beam carries four roto-moulded seats on the Deluxe Multi See Saw. Our installers grout it in or fix it self-standing, depending on the base. With four riders, check the central pivot more often than on a two-seat model, and keep a soft surface under both ends.
flags: Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: The Double See Saw is cross-shaped, with four Knight Blue seats on two beams that meet at a central pivot. Two pairs of children can rock at the same time, each pair facing the other across the cross. It suits the 3 to 9 years Key User Group and carries four. The cross layout takes up 8'2" x 6'9" and needs a safe play area of 12'2" x 10'9". Because it is more square than long, it fits a corner of a garden where a straight four-seat see saw would not. The galvanised frame and roto-moulded seats come with a 3-year warranty, and bearings with 1 year. Ask us to plan it into your layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.spec_paragraph: Both beams are galvanised steel, joined at a central pivot, with roto-moulded seats at each end. Grouting or a self-standing base is chosen to match your ground. Keep impact-absorbing flooring under all four seats and check the central pivot and seat bolts during maintenance.
flags: Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: Two blue horse-shaped seats turn the Horse See Saw into a pretend ride for small children. Each child sits astride a horse and holds on as they rock up and down. It is sized for the 3 to 6 years Key User Group and seats two. The horse shape gives younger children a seat they can grip with their knees, which helps them feel steady. Allow 7' x 2'3" for the see saw itself and 11' x 6'3" for its safe play area. Colours are Knight Blue and Play Orange. It suits a play school, nursery or society toddler area. Galvanised pipe and roto-moulded horses are covered for 3 years against manufacturing defects. Ask us for a quote and layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.spec_paragraph: The horses are roto-moulded plastic on a galvanised steel beam, so the see saw will not rust in humid weather. It can stand on its own base or be grouted into the ground. Place rubber flooring under both horses and check the pivot bearing, which carries a 1-year warranty, during maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: The Rainbow See Saw sets two blue seats on an arched beam shaped like a rainbow. The curved beam keeps the ride gentle and low, which suits the 3 to 6 years Key User Group. Two children ride at a time. It measures 6'4" x 1'7", the shortest of our see saws, with a safe play area of 10'4" x 5'7". That lets it fit along a narrow path or between two larger pieces. Its colour is Knight Blue. Parents of small children often look for a see saw with a modest height, and the rainbow arch gives exactly that. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts. Tell us your site size and we will check the fit.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.spec_paragraph: The arched beam is galvanised steel and the seats are roto-moulded. Fixing is by grouting or on a self-standing base. Even a low see saw needs a soft landing, so keep impact-absorbing flooring under the seats, and check the pivot, which has a 1-year warranty, during routine maintenance.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.description: On the Standing See Saw, children ride on their feet. Each end has a blue footrest inside a grey steel hoop, and the child holds the hoop while rocking up and down. Standing makes children use their legs and core to stay balanced, which is a different feel from a seated see saw. It is listed for the 3 to 6 years Key User Group and carries two. The see saw measures 6'10" x 1'7" and needs a safe play area of 10'10" x 5'7". The hoops give a firm grip all round, so children feel held even while standing. The colour is Knight Blue. Galvanised pipe on this see saw carries our 3-year warranty. Ask us for a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/see-saw/.spec_paragraph: Steel hoops and the beam are galvanised, and the footrests are moulded to give a grip underfoot. We grout it or install it self-standing. Keep an impact-absorbing surface below both ends, check the hoops and footrests for loose fittings, and inspect the pivot bearing during routine maintenance.
flags: A standing see saw listed for 3 to 6 years is unusual; confirm the age group.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/do.description: The Double Arc Swing hangs two yellow seats from a teal frame that curves over the top in a wide arch. It is meant for the 6 to 12 years Key User Group and carries two children. The arch gives the swing a clean, modern look that suits a new society garden or a school entrance lawn. The frame measures 9'4" x 3'7" and needs a safe play area of 11'4" x 13'2", most of it in front of and behind the seats. The colour is Horizon Teal. Swinging builds rhythm and coordination, and two seats let friends swing side by side. Galvanised pipes carry a 3-year warranty and bearings a 1-year warranty. Send us your site photos for a layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/do.spec_paragraph: The arched frame is galvanised pipe, so it resists rust through the monsoon. Our team fixes it self-standing or grouted. Keep the area in front of and behind the seats free of walkways and lay rubber flooring there. Check chains, seats and bearings regularly.
flags: Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/do.description: Straight teal posts at each end hold the two seats of the Double Post Swing. The upright design is simple and sturdy, and it lines up neatly against a boundary or alongside other equipment. It suits the 6 to 12 years Key User Group and seats two children. The product area is 9'4" x 3'2" and the safe play area 11'4" x 13'3". Schools often like a straight-post frame because it is easy to supervise from one side. It comes in Horizon Teal. Our warranty covers galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings and spare parts for 1 year, against manufacturing defects. Share the size of your play area and we will draw it into a layout.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/do.spec_paragraph: Both posts and the top bar are galvanised steel. We can fix the frame by grouting or on a self-standing base. Mark the swing path in front of and behind the seats on your site plan, keep it clear of benches and paths, and inspect the chains and bearings at each maintenance visit.
flags: Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/do.description: The Double Swing is the classic A-frame swing set, with two yellow belt seats hanging from a Horizon Teal frame. Belt seats bend to the child's shape, which many older children prefer. It suits the 6 to 12 years Key User Group and carries two. The A-frame stance takes up 8'10" x 7'6", and the safe play area is 10'10" x 13'3". It is a straightforward choice for a school ground, municipal park or society garden that wants a dependable swing. The galvanised frame carries our 3-year warranty, with 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us for a quote and we will show the swing zone on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/do.spec_paragraph: The A-frame legs are galvanised pipe, splayed for stability. It is installed self-standing or grouted, based on the ground at your site. Belt seats and chains wear with heavy use, so check them often and replace worn parts. Keep rubber flooring under the swing path.
flags: Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/gi.description: A tall curved teal frame shaped like a giraffe holds a single orange nest seat on the Giraffe Swing. The round nest seat lets a small child sit or lie in it, and it swings in a gentle arc. It is meant for the 3 to 6 years Key User Group and carries one child. The frame takes up 9'7" x 9'8" and needs a safe play area of 11'7" x 15'7". The giraffe shape makes it a strong theme piece for a nursery, play school or society toddler zone. The colour is Horizon Teal. The warranty runs 3 years on the galvanised frame and roto-moulded seat, and 1 year on bearings. Ask us to place it on your layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/gi.spec_paragraph: The giraffe frame is galvanised pipe and the nest seat hangs from a bearing at the top. Fixing is by grouting or a self-standing base. Nest seats can swing in more than one direction, so keep the whole 11'7" x 15'7" area clear and check ropes or chains, the seat and the bearing regularly.
flags: Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.
Capacity 1 on a nest seat; confirm, since nest seats often take more than one child.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/in.description: The In-Curve Post Swing has teal posts that bend inward at the top to hold two yellow seats. That inward curve gives the frame a rounded outline, a softer look than straight posts. It suits the 6 to 12 years Key User Group and seats two. The frame is 9'1" x 3'8", and the safe play area is 11'2" x 13'3". Societies often choose this design when the play area is visible from the clubhouse or main lawn, because the shape looks neat from any angle. The colour is Horizon Teal. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipes against manufacturing defects, and bearings and spares are covered for 1 year. Send us your site details for a quote.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/in.spec_paragraph: Curved galvanised posts carry the top bar, and the seats hang on chains from bearings. Installation is self-standing or grouted, whichever your ground needs. Keep the swing path free of other equipment, lay an impact-absorbing surface under it, and check the chains and bearings at regular intervals.
flags: Image description names the Curve Post Swing, not the In-Curve Post Swing. Check that the correct photo is used.
Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/mo.description: The Mother Child Swing lets a parent and a toddler swing together. A Horizon Teal A-frame holds a yellow seat for the adult and a toddler seat facing it, so the two ride face to face. It is meant for the 2 to 4 years Key User Group, with capacity for two. The frame is 5'5" x 7'6" and needs a safe play area of 7'5" x 12'9". This is a thoughtful addition for a society garden or public park where parents bring very young children. Swinging face to face keeps the child close and calm. The galvanised frame carries a 3-year warranty, and bearings carry 1 year. Ask us how it fits next to your other play pieces.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/mo.spec_paragraph: The frame is galvanised pipe on a splayed A-frame base. It can be fixed self-standing or grouted in. Keep the swing path clear and surfaced with rubber flooring. An adult rider adds load, so check the toddler seat, chains and bearings regularly.
flags: Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.

/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/to.description: Two toddler bucket swings hang from a teal palm-tree post on the Toddler Swing. Bucket seats wrap around a small child's legs and back, so they sit securely while an adult pushes. It is meant for the 2 to 4 years Key User Group and seats two. The palm-tree design gives a nursery, play school or toddler corner a playful look. The frame takes up 8'8" x 3'6" and needs a safe play area of 10'8" x 12'1". Its colour is Horizon Teal. Our 3-year warranty covers galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts, and bearings and spare parts are covered for 1 year. Share your site photos and we will show it on a layout drawing.
/corecraft/individual-equipment/swing/to.spec_paragraph: The palm-tree post is galvanised steel and the bucket seats are moulded for small children. We install it self-standing or by grouting into the ground. Keep the swing zone clear of walkways so toddlers do not wander into a moving seat, and inspect the chains, buckets and bearings regularly.
flags: Dimensions are prefixed "Diameter" though they are length x width figures.
